cadence: The proposal circles have met when the circle was ready — five times between 12 and 20 November 2026. The next one is announced on the join page, never here first.
timezoneNote: Times are shown in your own clock; the host speaks from Chiang Mai (UTC+7).

join.label: Join the circle · the one public door
join.note: No raw meeting link is ever published here. The join page is the only path in; no ticket, no conductor, every voice counts.

record.label: Record your circle the same way · PIT protocol
steps: Consent is asked out loud, on the recording itself.
The host hits record last; nothing is cut.
Nothing goes public until everyone has said yes and the transcript has been checked.
First names only. Takedown first, questions second.
